title: 热敷袋·完整独立纸件
prompt: Create ONE isolated reusable object for a refined medical paper-theatre animation. Style: exquisite handmade fibrous cut-paper collage, gouache and fine colored-pencil shading, tactile layered paper edges, warm muted cream/teal/ochre/terracotta palette; a high-quality raster object, not a flat SVG icon. Complete object centered with comfortable empty alpha margins. Genuine RGBA transparency outside the object. No human, hands, scene, floor, backdrop, cast background halo, text, digits, brands, logos or extra objects. Subject: one soft warm dusty-terracotta rubber hot-water bag with short closed screw neck and a subtle ribbed body surface, resting flat at a slight three-quarter angle. No steam, no temperature digits, no cloth, no body or skin. A recognizable safe closed heat pack, not a medicine bottle, not an IV bag.
